highest_positive_margin.question: What were the operational and strategic challenges faced by the CAOC during the air campaign in Afghanistan?

The Air Component Commander had to repeatedly remind staff of the campaign's purpose. lowest_negative_margin.question: What is the main thesis of the book 'Why Vietnam' by Frank N. Trager, and what is the author's background?
lowest_negative_margin.target_answer: The main thesis of 'Why Vietnam' by Frank N. Trager concerns the international legality of American involvement in Vietnam. The author develops this argument by examining the history of Vietnamese resistance to alien domination, the deficiencies of the 1954 Geneva Conference, and the agreements between the USA and the Republic of Vietnam. Trager is a professor of International Affairs at New York University and a former director of the Point Four Programme in Burma, with extensive experience in Southeast Asia and a record of writing on Asian affairs.
lowest_negative_margin.everyday_answer: The book 'Why Vietnam' by Frank N. Trager mainly looks at whether the US involvement in Vietnam was legal under international law. Trager explains this by looking at Vietnam's history of fighting against foreign control, problems with the 1954 Geneva Conference, and agreements between the US and South Vietnam. Trager is a professor who has worked in Southeast Asia and has written a lot about Asian issues.
